title: App navigation graph
description: The whole-app screen catalogue (P1a-04) as nodes and the navigation edges between them. Sanitized: semantic names and evidence IDs only; the real route/class map is in local/evidence/.

nodes.description: One per screen-level destination the app declares.

id.description: Stable node ID. F-001/F-002/F-066 reuse the P1a-03 inventory IDs; every other screen is S-###.

name.description: Semantic screen name (no class, package, brand or resource strings).

area.description: P1a-03 feature-area ID, or F-000 when the area could not be resolved.

dynamic.description: True when the destination is server-driven (its presence or content is chosen by the backend).

edges.description: Navigation steps recovered from the navigation call sites.

to.description: Destination node ID, or null when the destination is not statically resolvable (then dynamic must be true).

dynamic.description: True when the destination is server-driven or built from a computed/encrypted route.

label.description: Evidence label. Observed is never used in static steps (the app was not run).
